positive.query: A backend engineer starts on Monday. Build their onboarding plan with a first week schedule and 30/60/90 outcomes.
Create a reusable onboarding template for our support team with a buddy program and a manager checklist.
What should I have ready before my new account executive's start date, and how do I measure time to productivity?

nearMiss.query: Write the job description for the backend engineer role we are hiring.
Build a structured interview kit with scoring rubrics for our account executive candidates.
Design the first-run onboarding flow and empty states for new users of our mobile app.

holdout.query: Our first remote financial analyst joins next month. Plan day one, stakeholder introductions, a learning plan, and check-ins for the first 90 days.

scenarios.task: Hypothetical facts: a mid-level customer success manager starts in two weeks, working remotely. They will take over a book of accounts from a departing colleague who leaves one month after the start date. The team uses a CRM, a support ticketing tool, and a shared forecast sheet. The manager has weekly one-to-ones with the team. Build the onboarding plan.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline gives a generic checklist (meet the team, read the handbook) with vague 30/60/90 goals that could apply to any role, no first contribution, no access lead times, and no success measures.
